note: Kinetic campaigns and how the current-event publication policy applies to each (docs/CURRENT_EVENT_PUBLICATION_POLICY.md). Status is a curated fact with a dated basis, re-checked when a country is researched. Read by pipeline/build_systems.py and scripts/import_candidates.py.

release_rule.text: Facility-specific restart, recovery or operating status for a record in a campaign is published only once the campaign is recorded as ended and 30 days have passed. While it is active the event itself is published; its facility status is not.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Saudi energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Attacks on Saudi energy facilities were still being reported in late October 2026, and no ceasefire was found (independent review, 2026-10-31).

also_covers.reason: Its own cause is unknown, but the site is a 2026 strike target (sa-2026-04-juaymah-processing-fires): its export status is that facility's status.

campaigns.name: Strikes on energy infrastructure in Russia, Belarus and Crimea, 2022 onward
campaigns.status_basis: Strikes continue to be reported (the theatre's own daily build).

policy_rule.text: Occurrence is published at administrative-region level as before. A recovery record for a campaign incident (restart, restoration, repair estimate or current status) is used for display, scoring and the build ledger only once its evidence is at least methodology/scoring.json campaign_publication.evidence_embargo_days old and any repair estimate it carries has run its course; until then the incident is scored on the modelled class horizon and the dossier says why. Recorded withheld records are counted, never named. A current build refuses to run with an embargoed record in the curated file, because the repository is published too.
policy_rule.differs_from_country_rule: Saudi Arabia keeps full withholding (no facility status until the campaign ends + 30 days, release_rule A). The theatre's index is built on recovery evidence, so it releases evidence once it is history instead; docs/OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DELAY_OPTIONS.md.
